due_when.clears_when: 10148 with state PendingCancel reports a distinct in-flight state, with a test

terminal_reason: Fixed on main: scripts/ops/cancel_ib_order.py grades IBKR 10148 with state PendingCancel as its own in-flight state (comment L97-101, note L312) instead of refused_by_venue, and tests/test_cancel_ib_order.py covers PendingCancel. Checked 2026-09-30.
what: scripts/ops/cancel_ib_order.py grades IBKR 10148 'cannot be cancelled, state: PendingCancel' as refused_by_venue with note 'the order is still resting ... will not change that' (#13216). PendingCancel means a cancel is already in flight (here: the OCA sibling cancel after 906), not a refusal; the report misdirects the operator. Classify 10148+PendingCancel as a third state (cancel_in_flight).
